before_taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: During a provider-confirmed major outage, an unused free account was represented as prompt-limit exhausted and shown a Pro upgrade path, collapsing provider downtime into a false allowance/plan state with a different recovery path. A separate contemporaneous reporter account also documented restored login with continuing prompt-processing errors, followed by a model-specific unavailability message suggesting a model switch. The reported switch did not return a response. This second access-state failure conflated a model-specific recovery suggestion with broader unusable prompt-processing service for the observed account; it is distinct from the previously evidenced false free-plan allowance state.
